us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Justice Department inquiry seeks interviews tied to Mar-a-Lago search
bullets: Investigators sought interviews with law enforcement officials connected to the 2022 FBI search of Mar-a-Lago.
The inquiry is examining whether officials conspired against President Donald Trump, according to AP sources.
The interview requests were voluntary and not subpoenas, AP reported.

articles.title: Aisha Wahab wins special election for Eric Swalwell’s House seat
bullets: California state Sen. Aisha Wahab won the special election in the state’s 14th Congressional District.
She will serve the remainder of former Rep. Eric Swalwell’s term, which ends in January.
AP reported Wahab will be the first Afghan American to serve in Congress.

articles.title: Trump appears on Michael Cohen’s radio show after years-long feud
bullets: President Donald Trump appeared on former fixer Michael Cohen’s radio show Thursday.
The interview marked a public reunion after Cohen had testified against Trump in court and Congress.
AP reported the exchange was friendly and followed a behind-the-scenes detente.

articles.title: USS George Washington carrier arrives in Middle East
bullets: The USS George Washington is operating in the Middle East, the U.S. military said Thursday.
It is relieving the USS Abraham Lincoln after an unusually long deployment supporting the Iran war.
AP reported lawmakers have raised concerns about conditions aboard the Lincoln.

articles.title: Charter plane crashes near remote western Alaska radar site
bullets: A charter plane carrying eight people crashed near Cape Newenham in western Alaska.
The aircraft had taken off from Anchorage, according to the National Transportation Safety Board’s Alaska official.
The crash occurred near a remote radar site, AP reported.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Top worldwide developments from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil organizers convicted in national security case
bullets: Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung were convicted Friday of inciting subversion.
The two helped lead Hong Kong’s long-running Tiananmen Square crackdown vigils.
They face sentencing later under Hong Kong’s Beijing-imposed national security law.

articles.title: Trump warns Iran of ‘economic D-Day’ as sanctions pressure builds
bullets: The Trump administration is preparing what it calls a crushing financial campaign against Tehran.
The warning comes near the six-month mark of the Iran war.
AP reported Iran has rejected the pressure campaign and remains familiar with decades of U.S. sanctions.

articles.title: Iran says vessels cannot transit Hormuz without its permission
bullets: Iran’s military said no vessel can pass through the Strait of Hormuz without its permission.
Al Jazeera reported the statement amid continued U.S.-Iran tensions and stalled talks.
The Strait remains central to global oil shipping and regional escalation risks.

articles.title: Oman oil spill containment begins after tanker strike
bullets: Al Jazeera reported that a British firm began containment work after an oil spill reached Oman’s coastline.
The spill followed attacks on vessels and infrastructure near key Gulf waterways.
The incident has raised environmental concerns along Oman’s coast.

articles.title: Houthis launch drone strike on Saudi Aramco refinery
bullets: Al Jazeera reported a Houthi drone strike on an Aramco refinery in Jizan, Saudi Arabia.
The attack came amid wider escalation around Yemen and Red Sea shipping routes.
The report followed recent Houthi attacks on regional ports and vessels.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India’s Supreme Court forms panel to probe youth protest violence claims
bullets: India’s Supreme Court created a panel to examine allegations of police violence during youth protests.
The protests followed leaks of medical entrance exam papers and led to the education minister’s resignation.
Reuters reported the panel will include a former Supreme Court judge, retired judges and retired police chiefs.

articles.title: India eases rupee export-payment rules to widen trade settlement
bullets: India changed trade-policy rules to allow more export contracts and invoices to be settled in rupees.
The move gives rupee payments the same trade-policy benefit treatment as foreign-currency earnings.
Reuters reported the policy aims to promote wider use of the rupee in global trade.

articles.title: India set to approve $1.2 billion construction-equipment incentive plan
bullets: India is preparing a $1.2 billion incentive scheme for high-value construction and infrastructure equipment.
The plan targets machinery such as tunnel-boring machines, firefighting equipment and elevators.
Reuters reported the goal is to cut dependence on China for critical equipment.

articles.title: Coal India plans Singapore hub for minerals trading
bullets: Coal India is setting up its first overseas trading office in Singapore, Reuters reported.
The office is expected to support trading in iron ore and critical and strategic minerals.
The move fits India’s broader push to secure overseas mineral supplies.

articles.title: Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman likely to visit India next week
bullets: Bangladesh Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is likely to visit India from August 23 to 25, Reuters reported citing Indian Express.
It would be Rahman’s first India trip since taking office in February.
The visit comes as New Delhi and Dhaka try to repair strained ties after Sheikh Hasina’s ouster.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Top market movers and market-moving stories

articles.title: Walmart shares slide after rare U.S. sales miss
bullets: Walmart reported its slowest quarterly comparable-sales growth in six years.
Reuters said shares fell as much as 10% as investors weighed pressure on consumers from higher gasoline prices.
The company still raised its annual sales and profit forecasts.

articles.title: Bond-yield rebound knocks U.S. stocks lower
bullets: The S&P 500, Nasdaq and Dow fell Thursday as Treasury yields rebounded.
AP reported the Dow dropped more than 700 points and the Nasdaq fell 1%.
Walmart’s earnings reaction added pressure on consumer-related stocks.

articles.title: U.S. stock futures rebound after selloff, but indexes face weekly losses
bullets: U.S. stock-index futures regained ground Friday after Thursday’s sharp declines.
Reuters reported the S&P 500 and Nasdaq were on pace to snap three-week winning streaks.
Markets remained pressured by surging long-dated Treasury yields and geopolitical uncertainty.

articles.title: Paramount Skydance appears among CNBC’s midday movers
bullets: CNBC listed Paramount Skydance among stocks making the biggest midday moves.
The stock was grouped with Cava, Capri and SailPoint in the market-movers roundup.
The move came during a broader session focused on rotation and rate-sensitive stocks.

articles.title: Cava featured in CNBC’s biggest midday movers list
bullets: CNBC identified Cava as one of the notable midday stock movers.
The restaurant chain was included alongside Paramount Skydance, Capri and SailPoint.
Recent investor attention has focused on Cava’s quarterly sales, traffic and outlook.

articles.title: Walmart to use nearly $3 billion in tariff refunds to lower prices
bullets: Walmart said it has received substantially all of roughly $2.9 billion in tariff refunds.
The retailer plans to reinvest the money into price cuts and customer experience.
Fortune reported Walmart now has more than 11,000 items on rollback.

articles.title: Port of Los Angeles posts second-highest July volume
bullets: The Port of Los Angeles processed 960,464 TEUs of container cargo in July.
Reuters reported demand was supported by consumer goods and parts for manufacturing and data-center projects.
The port’s chief said the momentum should support another strong August.

articles.title: Coal India plans overseas trading hub in Singapore
bullets: Coal India is preparing its first overseas trading office in Singapore.
The hub would help the company trade iron ore and critical minerals.
Reuters reported the plan supports India’s efforts to reduce supply dependence on China.

articles.title: India readies $1.2 billion equipment-manufacturing incentive plan
bullets: The planned incentive scheme targets advanced construction and infrastructure equipment.
Reuters reported it could attract $1.8 billion in fresh investment over seven years.
Eligible products include tunnel-boring machines, elevators and firefighting systems.

articles.title: Cava keeps forecast unchanged after quarterly beat
bullets: Cava beat Wall Street expectations for second-quarter sales and core profit.
Reuters reported the company kept its annual forecast unchanged, citing prudence.
Management said sales affected by produce concerns had begun to recover.

articles.title: OpenAI gains on Anthropic among business users, new Ramp data indicates
bullets: TechCrunch reported Ramp data showing OpenAI growing faster than Anthropic among its business customers in Q3 to date.
Anthropic still led among Ramp’s paying business users as of July.
The data covers more than 70,000 U.S. businesses using Ramp products.

articles.title: ChatGPT adds Apple Messages plug-in for drafting and sending texts
bullets: OpenAI launched an Apple Messages plug-in for ChatGPT, TechCrunch reported.
The feature can draft, search, delete and send messages with user permission.
TechCrunch noted the tool raises privacy questions despite OpenAI saying it runs locally.

articles.title: Google gives publishers a new tool to counter AI-driven traffic declines
bullets: Google is letting publishers embed a Preferred Sources button on their websites.
Readers can use it to signal sources they want highlighted more in Search, Discover and Google News.
TechCrunch reported the move follows publisher concerns about AI reducing web traffic.

articles.title: Ramp launches AI model router called Router
bullets: Ramp introduced its own AI model router, TechCrunch reported.
The product is designed to help route AI tasks across different models.
The launch reflects growing enterprise focus on AI cost, performance and workflow management.

articles.title: U.S. says hackers are using AI to target vulnerable water systems
bullets: U.S. officials warned that hackers are targeting water systems with help from AI, TechCrunch reported.
The warning focuses on vulnerable public infrastructure and cybersecurity gaps.
The report adds to rising concern about AI-assisted cyberattacks on critical systems.
